blocks.text_en: In E2E Profile 11 with DataIDMode set to E2E_P11_DA T AID_NIBBLE, the lower nibble of the high byte of the DataID shall be placed in the transmitted data at bit position DataIDNibbleOffset, and the CRC calculation shall be done by first calculating over the low byte of the Data ID, then a 0-byte, and then the user data
